accelerator_facing_interface.name: logical_core_refill
accelerator_facing_interface.selection_basis: Explicit core binding preserves a 512-bit logical refill behind a board-boundary adapter.

source_evidence.excerpt: Keep the core's 512-bit logical refill and bounded active/shadow caches; derive a legal physical U280 memory binding at the board boundary.

Its parameterized hbm_m_axi_* interface defaults to 32 pseudo-channels. Each physical HBM channel has 256-bit read data, 33-bit addresses, 6-bit IDs, 4-bit burst length, 3-bit size, 2-bit burst type, RRESP, RLAST and ready/valid.

The shell also has a gamma_m_axi_* read interface with 512-bit data, 37-bit addresses, 5-bit IDs and 8-bit burst length. It is a distinct interface; do not conflate its widths with the HBM channel widths.

width_clock_adaptation.description: Derive a legal U280 board-boundary binding from the 512-bit logical core refill to the physical memory interfaces. Preserve the logical core stream width; do not narrow it to the 256-bit per-channel HBM port. HBM IP AXI clock is evidenced at 450 MHz while the core timing target is 150 MHz, so clock-domain adaptation remains required.
